questions.body_en: Find the missing number. Three circles each contain three numbers arranged around a central number. The first circle has 9 (top), 13 (middle), 12 (bottom-left), 8 (bottom-right). The second circle has 12 (top), 20 (middle), 15 (bottom-left), 7 (bottom-right). The third circle has 6 (top), ? (middle), 9 (bottom-left), 1 (bottom-right).
questions.body_id: Temukan angka yang hilang. Tiga lingkaran masing-masing berisi tiga angka yang disusun di sekitar angka tengah. Lingkaran pertama memiliki 9 (atas), 13 (tengah), 12 (kiri bawah), 8 (kanan bawah). Lingkaran kedua memiliki 12 (atas), 20 (tengah), 15 (kiri bawah), 7 (kanan bawah). Lingkaran ketiga memiliki 6 (atas), ? (tengah), 9 (kiri bawah), 1 (kanan bawah).

questions.body_en: Some students gathered in the hall. They were then asked to stand in a rectangular grid formation. James observes that there are 3 students in front of him and 1 student behind him. There are 5 students to his left and 3 students to his right. How many students are there in the hall?
questions.body_id: Beberapa siswa berkumpul di aula. Mereka kemudian diminta berdiri dalam formasi kotak-kotak persegi panjang. James mengamati bahwa ada 3 siswa di depannya dan 1 siswa di belakangnya. Ada 5 siswa di sebelah kirinya dan 3 siswa di sebelah kanannya. Ada berapa banyak siswa di aula?

questions.body_en: Cindy had $45 at first. Diane had $62 at first. Their mum gave them $70 to share. After they split the money, Diane has twice as much money as Cindy. How much money did Diane receive?
questions.body_id: Cindy awalnya memiliki $45. Diane awalnya memiliki $62. Ibu mereka memberi mereka $70 untuk dibagi. Setelah mereka membagi uang tersebut, Diane memiliki dua kali lebih banyak uang daripada Cindy. Berapa banyak uang yang Diane terima?

questions.body_en: Odd numbers are numbers that cannot be divided by 2. Examples of odd numbers include: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, … At the start, there are 20 students standing in a row. Each student is assigned a number in order 1, 2, 3, … consecutively from left to right. The students who are assigned an odd number are asked to sit. The students who remain standing are then assigned new numbers 1, 2, 3, … in consecutive order again. Then, those with odd numbers are asked to sit. This process continues until Roy was the only one left standing. What was the first number that was assigned to Roy at the start?
questions.body_id: Bilangan ganjil adalah bilangan yang tidak bisa dibagi 2. Contoh bilangan ganjil antara lain: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, … Pada awalnya, ada 20 siswa berdiri dalam satu baris. Setiap siswa diberi nomor urut 1, 2, 3, … secara berurutan dari kiri ke kanan. Siswa yang mendapat nomor ganjil diminta untuk duduk. Siswa yang tetap berdiri kemudian diberi nomor baru 1, 2, 3, … secara berurutan lagi. Kemudian, siswa dengan nomor ganjil diminta untuk duduk. Proses ini berlanjut sampai Roy menjadi satu-satunya yang masih berdiri. Nomor pertama apakah yang diberikan kepada Roy di awal?
